description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon/rules/central_D_lon_zero_grad_bc — the esm-spec 9.6.8 worked example generalized over NLON/NLAT metaparameters and the consumer-supplied spacing free name. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLON=8, NLAT=5 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: D(u,lon) replaced by the rule's two-axis makearray (interior centered-difference stencil over [2,7] x [1,5]; one-sided zero-gradient aggregates over the lat axis at the i=1 and i=8 face columns), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, and the spacing surviving as the free name dlon_deg. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
